chunks: And whoever obeys Allah and the Messenger - those will be with those whom Allah has blessed of the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous; and excellent are those as companions.

key_terms.الصِّدِّيقِينَ: The Truthful (those who are exceptionally sincere in faith and testimony)

ai.seo_question: Who are the four categories of people blessed by God mentioned in Surah An-Nisa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the concept of *Tawalli*, where obedience to the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt ensures inclusion in the ranks of the *Siddiqun* (truthful ones), a title often specifically associated with Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib. The verse underscores the spiritual continuity between prophetic revelation and the righteous successors, promising an elevated companionship (*Hasuna Ula'ika Rafiqan*) that reflects the divine favor bestowed upon the elect.
